subject.title: [Feishu] "This reply completed without visible content" fallback incorrectly triggered for long/markdown-heavy replies (regression from #87896)

question: Is the supplied session-level telemetry enough to promote a repair now, or should maintainers require a live Feishu/trajectory reproduction that shows where the long markdown final disappears before coding?
rationale: The bug is plausible and high-impact, but source review does not yet prove whether the failure is final extraction, source-reply suppression, Feishu text/card delivery, streaming-card close, or count reconciliation.

options.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
options.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu direct-chat transcript, gateway logs, and session trajectory showing assistant final text, delivery attempts, failed counts, and the fallback trigger before implementing a fix.

options.title: Promote a guarded source investigation
options.body: Allow a repair worker to add a focused regression harness only if it first reproduces the zero-final long-markdown path without broadly changing fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu direct-chat transcript, gateway logs, and session trajectory showing assistant final text, delivery attempts, failed counts, and the fallback trigger before implementing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the maintainer repair work across the Feishu fallback and shared dispatch paths in the merged fallback PR.
